payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited background as a whole read as a basketball court?
node.criteria: Pass if the combined visible background establishes a recognizable basketball-court setting. Weigh the playing surface, visible lines, hoop or other basketball equipment, and surrounding scene together. Distinguish recognizable court markings from a thin or boundary-like line that alone may not establish a court. Basketball equipment alone is insufficient, but a dark or plain upper backdrop alone is not decisive if the rest of the scene establishes a court. Fail if the visible background clearly does not read as a court. Use unknown when the visible surface, markings, and context leave the court identity genuinely ambiguous; do not treat uncertainty as failure.
node.binding: Judge completion of the requested background replacement from the entire visible background. Assess whether the combined scene reads as a basketball court, rather than requiring any particular unsupported feature or letting isolated equipment, a narrow line, or a plain upper backdrop decide the result alone. Keep this completion judgment separate from s2's progress judgment.
